Then, Samantha is a teen who was blinded by her love affair with her allegedly abusive boyfriend, Aaron. Don't miss her update and somber words for Sammie, whom she fears may be walking blindly down the perilous path she says she knows too well.

Despite cutting the teen off financially, Dina says her ultimatums fell flat and fears they may only have pushed Sammie further into the arms of a boyfriend she thinks is bad news and may be dangerous. Sammie says her controlling mother and sheltered upbringing are the real problems - but, can she explain the bruises on her body? Then, Samantha is a teen who was blinded by her love affair with her allegedly abusive boyfriend, Aaron. Don't miss her update and somber words for Sammie, whom she fears may be walking blindly down the perilous path she says she knows too well.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongest Man of Holland, Alex Moonen and the “Flying Dutchman” Kelvin de Ruiter, competing in Holland against 12 other strongest men in the world. There were 6 events in total, 3 in this second episode; a Viking-press of 150 kg with the current world record holder Luke Herrick. The fifth event, a front hold of 25 kg is loved or hated by the athletes and lastly, the Stones of Strength.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you worry your teen daughter could throw away everything she's worked for - all for young love? Dina says she gave her daughter, Sammie, everything she'd ever wanted, but the 19-year-old is now only interested in one thing: her 20-year-old boyfriend, Chris, who has a criminal record. Despite cutting the teen off financially, Dina says her ultimatums fell flat and fears they may only have pushed Sammie further into the arms of a boyfriend she thinks is bad news and may be dangerous. Sammie says her controlling mother and sheltered upbringing are the real problems - but, can she explain the bruises on her body? Then, Samantha is a teen who was blinded by her love affair with her allegedly abusive boyfriend, Aaron. Don't miss her update and somber words for Sammie, whom she fears may be walking blindly down the perilous path she says she knows too well.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today's episode is all about corn. Lidia often played in corn fields, helped with the harvests, and even slept on mattresses made from husks. Recipes for today include a refreshing Corn and Zucchini Minestra, a sweet and savory Polenta Cacio e Pere, and a combination of vegetables that can be served as a side dish or even the highlight of the dinner table- Grilled Corn, Apricots, and Portobellos.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Alberto Elías Orozco, empresario dueño de la fábrica "Yogurozco" en Cali, fue asesinado junto a su esposa Macclly Arbeláez en marzo de 2012 cuando se dirigían a misa. Tras varias hipótesis, se descubrió que su propio hermano, Juan Carlos, contrató sicarios para matarlos, motivado por la codicia y el deseo de convertirse en el único heredero de sus bienes.

Tras varias hipótesis, se descubrió que su propio hermano, Juan Carlos, contrató sicarios para matarlos, motivado por la codicia y el deseo de convertirse en el único heredero de sus bienes.

programme.desc: Ty has been bowhunting for a very long time. He knows that sometimes a season can be one to remember and there can be seasons to forget. This season just about became one to forget. programme.title: La nature, terre de découvertes et d'apprentissages
programme.desc: Ali Baddou welcomes Nikos Aliagas, journalist and television host, passionate about photography. His shots will be exhibited at the Musée de l'Homme, in Paris, as part of the exhibition Les grands âges (from 8 April 2026 to 3 January 2027). The genius of Rembrandt through the eye of Alex Vizorek, and the work of the painter Jacques-Louis David, seen by the art historian Hector Obalk.

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE
programme.desc: Dans le Bas-Vivarais, Christophe Chaussy ouvre les portes d'une ferme familiale entre élevage de porcs et fabrication de charcuterie.
